hero.headline: Bath Remodeling Live Transfers
hero.subheadline: Connect with high-intent consumers actively looking for bath remodeling solutions.

overview: Bath Remodeling Live Transfers are consumers qualified by our team and warm-transferred to your agents, generated by Altarious Global performance campaigns and delivered to your business in real time. Connect with homeowners planning bath and shower remodels and route them to remodelers ready to quote the project.

Live transfers add a qualification layer before the call reaches the sales team. Our team confirms the homeowner owns the property, is within the service area, and has a defined project and budget before warm-transferring the call, so appointment setters spend time only with homeowners who can actually move forward. This is especially valuable for remodelers with limited install capacity, because the pre-screen removes renters and out-of-area homeowners before they consume sales time.

This product is suited to home services businesses with a team ready to answer during defined hours, a clear view of the consumer they want, and the capacity to convert a live conversation. The acquisition objective is simple: put your team in front of bath remodeling consumers at the moment they are deciding.
targetConsumer: Homeowners aged 35 and older who own a single-family home and are planning a bath or shower project. The strongest segments are owners of older homes with dated bathrooms, households looking for safer, more accessible bathing such as walk-in tubs, and homeowners who want a tub-to-shower conversion and have budget set aside for the work.
consumerIntent: Typical intent signals include: searching for bathroom or shower remodel options; interested in a walk-in tub or accessible bathing; wants a tub-to-shower conversion; has an outdated bathroom in need of renovation.
howGenerated: Consumers are acquired through performance campaigns targeting searches such as "bathroom remodel near me" and "walk in tub installation", plus social and comparison placements. Interested consumers speak with our qualification team before any transfer is attempted.
qualification: Qualification is configured to your appetite. Standard bath remodeling criteria include: owns the home where the work will be performed; located in the remodeler's service area; has a defined bath or shower project in mind; has budget available and is planning to move forward; age 18 or older and a decision maker for the household; willing to schedule an in-home consultation or estimate.
delivery: Once qualified, the consumer is bridged directly to your designated number or queue with a warm introduction. Delivery runs only during your operating hours with daily caps, and you can pause or adjust criteria at any time.

faq.q: Can bath remodeling calls be limited to my service area?
faq.a: Yes. Campaigns can be filtered to the specific ZIP codes and regions your crews serve, so you only receive homeowners you can actually schedule and complete.

faq.q: Can programs focus on a specific project type?
faq.a: Yes. Delivery can prioritise walk-in tubs, tub-to-shower conversions, full bath renovations or shower replacements, depending on the projects your business specialises in.

faq.q: Are homeowners screened for ownership and budget?
faq.a: Yes. Programs confirm property ownership and a defined project with available budget so your team spends time with homeowners who are prepared to schedule an in-home consultation.
